title: dactylis polygama f. macrocephala
intro: Dactylis polygama f. macrocephala, commonly known as Meadow Grass or Orchard Grass, is a type of perennial grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including the alleviation of digestive issues, fever reduction, and the treatment of coughs and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Dactylis polygama f. macrocephala include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it a popular choice in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
